professionalSummary: Customer data platform engineer at a marketing software company for three years, building merge-rule and consent-flag changes from the data product managers' design notes under the platform engineering standard.
Thirty-nine pull requests merged in my name.

experienceHighlights: Sat down with the marketing and support product managers before each rollout under the rollout communication standard, showing them what would change on their screens; each pull request links the session note and the product managers' acknowledgement.
Shipped every change behind a canary, with the canary result attached to the pull request before the rollout.
Rollouts went ahead on the platform lead's approval, recorded on the pull request with the checks that were mine listed separately.
The boundary of every change and what the next engineer needs to know are written into the pull request description.
